brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 added at level 0 from 0,0 entryEdge4 through 1,0 2,0 3,0 — pipe passes through all four bases

finish.summary: Built 4-cell linear cluster at q 0-3, r 0 with a single irrigation run traversing all cells (0,0 → 3,0). Mesh is clear. Attempted planter bins (third-depth drained) clash with pvc-coupling per configurator rule for pipe-through-cell (MESH_CLASH 1.875mm), so bases themselves serve as planter cells; pipe feed to every cell is verified.

lines.key: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 147 mm over 1 corner
lines.label: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 147 mm over 1 corner

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
buy 1 x 25 ft 3/4 in FLEXIBLE PVC, IPS, OD 26.67 mm (US), glues into Sch 40 sockets
- flexible legs are pool/spa grade hose: irrigation only, NOT potable and not for indoor plumbing
- glue with Weld-On 795 flexible-PVC cement and P-68/P-70 primer, not ordinary rigid cement
- keep every bend clear of its glued socket: the joint fails long before the pipe does
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
